questions.q: How many marks is Cambridge IGCSE German Paper 4 (Writing) worth, and how long is it?
questions.why: Paper 4 is 1 hour and 45 marks (Q1 form 5, Q2 directed writing 12, Q3 extended writing 28), 25% of the grade.

questions.q: In the Speaking test, what is each of the five role-play answers worth?
questions.why: Each role-play answer is marked out of 2 (5 × 2 = 10); the two topic conversations carry the other 30 marks.

questions.q: Which statement about Paper 1 Listening is correct?
options: Answers are short written German sentences
It has multiple-choice and matching questions, and each recording is played twice
questions.why: Paper 1 has 37 multiple-choice and matching questions (40 marks); every text is heard twice and the paper is 25%.

questions.q: Describe how to approach Writing Q3 (130–140 words) so that you earn both communication and language marks.
questions.model: Choose the task, plan before writing, cover every bullet point with relevant detail and an opinion with a reason, use different time frames (past, present, future or conditional), link sentences with conjunctions such as weil and dass, stay near 130–140 words and check verb position, noun capitals and cases.
points: Covers all bullet points / relevant, developed content
Uses a range of tenses and structures (past, present, future/conditional) and opinions with reasons
Checks accuracy (verb position, endings, capitals) and keeps to the word count
